observations.body: Jesus says Satan asked to sift the disciples, tells Peter he prayed that his faith not fail, charges him to strengthen brothers after turning, and predicts three denials.
observations.label: Satan’s demand, Jesus’ prayer, and Peter’s predicted turn

observations.body: The passage places Satan, Simon Peter, Jesus, and the brothers beside Sifting, praying, turning, and strengthening.

payload.posture: Read Luke 22:31–34 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
